rubric_items.contrast: Passes. Every label is dark on white: headings #1a1a1a give about 16.9:1, notes #5f5f5f about 6.4:1 and the blue accent #2f6fa8 about 5.5:1, all well clear of 4.5:1 for body text; the grey population lines and dots are marks rather than text, and the 'yes' and 'no' branch labels are #5f5f5f and #2f6fa8 respectively, both readable against the white ground.
rubric_items.data_ink: Passes. The ink carries only the drawing: two reader boxes feeding the 'any *.json in runs/ ?' gate, the two branches beneath it, the three-line note box, and three dot-and-text rows for the measured arms. There is no chart chrome, no grid, no legend box and no redundant mark; the store box's 3 pt blue outline is the one highlighted path, which is the subject the figure exists to show.
rubric_items.decoration: Passes. The canvas, all four boxes and the note box are plain white (the note box has a single thin #cccccc outline); there is no gradient, background fill, shading, drop shadow or styled theme anywhere in the render. The only filled shapes are the three 4 px dots, which encode the negative control, the base arm and the head arm.
rubric_items.label_collision: Passes. No label is clipped and none overlaps another or the data. Ink stays at least 39 px inside every canvas edge, the six text bands are disjoint, and every box's text sits inside its outline with at least 14 px to the nearest edge on its tightest side (16 px at the left of each box); the 'yes' and 'no' branch labels sit above their own connector lines rather than on them.
rubric_items.legibility: Passes. Readable at a glance: two titles ('ledger readers', 'any *.json in runs/ ?') over their notes, the branches labelled yes and no, the two destination boxes titled 'per-run documents + aggregate' and 'run store', then a single explanatory sentence and a three-row arm list whose dots carry their own colours. Every glyph is rendered (the earlier blank-box failure is gone), so a reader can follow the gate, the two sources and the three arm results without magnification.
rubric_items.table_form: Passes. The image is a source-precedence drawing, not a table drawn as boxes; the nine readers and what each answers are set out in a real table in the same evidence fragment, so the figure does not duplicate tabular information. The three arm rows are a short dot-and-text list with no columns to align.
